task_description: Create an MVP Integration Validation Matrix test suite in frontend/src/__integration__/ that validates the complete production chain as a single deterministic flow across all 10 areas: template integrity, canvas rules, SKU integrity, lighting, BOM generation, bidirectional sync, validation/errors, permissions, persistence, and end-to-end scenarios.

verification.summary: All 1022 tests pass (901 existing + 121 new integration tests). TypeScript type checking passes for all integration test files. Tests exercise real engine functions with realistic data and verify meaningful invariants.
